description: This file defines the IAVInput interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares various methods, notifications, and data structures related to AV input devices, their status, and control functionalities such as configuration, notifications, EDID management, input switching, and content protection.

classes.name: IAVInput
classes.description: Interface for managing and interacting with AV input devices, providing methods for device configuration, notification registration, input control, EDID management, and retrieving device info.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the AV input device with the provided service.

methods.name: RegisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for when AV input devices change.

methods.name: UnregisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered devices changed notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for signal change events.

methods.name: UnregisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters a signal change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for input status change events.

methods.name: UnregisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters an input status change notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a notification for video stream info updates.

methods.name: UnregisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the video stream info update notification callback.

methods.name: RegisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for game feature status updates.

methods.name: UnregisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the game feature status update callback.

methods.name: RegisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers a callback for AV content type updates.

methods.name: UnregisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters the AV content type update callback.

methods.name: NumberOfInputs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available AV input ports and success status.

methods.name: WriteEDID
methods.description: Writes a new EDID value to a specified port.

methods.name: ReadEDID
methods.description: Reads the current EDID value from a specified port.

methods.name: GetRawSPD
methods.description: Gets the raw SPD infoFrame packet for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: GetSPD
methods.description: Gets the SPD infoFrame packet for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: SetEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: GetEdidVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: SetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Sets the Allm support bit in EDID for a port.

methods.name: GetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Gets the Allm support bit from EDID for a port.

methods.name: SetVRRSupport
methods.description: Sets the VRR support bit in EDID.

methods.name: GetVRRSupport
methods.description: Gets the VRR support bit from EDID.

methods.name: GetHdmiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum HDMI version supported for a port.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets the audio mixer levels.

methods.name: StartInput
methods.description: Activates a specified input port with parameters for input type, audio, plane, and priority.

methods.name: StopInput
methods.description: Deactivates the current input port.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video window dimensions for a specified input.

methods.name: CurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current video mode for the active input.

methods.name: ContentProtected
methods.description: Checks if the content is protected for an input device.

methods.name: GetSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported game features.

methods.name: GetGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of a specific game feature (e.g., ALLM).

methods.name: GetVRRFrameRate
methods.description: Gets the current VRR frame rate for an input device.
